spans.s: -dheya (only ifc.; = Pali -dheyya), realm, sway, control (normally subst. in Pali, despite PTSD, and in BHS): anāgataṃ mṛtyudheyaṃ Ud 〔ii.8〕, … the realm of death (so Pali maccudheyya); parispandati vai cittaṃ māradheyaṃ (Pali also has māradheyya) prahātavai Ud 〔xxxi.2〕; bhrūṇa-dheya, q.v.
